record.question: The G20 members represent over
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
PIB’s 17 April 2023 release says G20 members represented around 85% of global GDP, over 75% of global trade and about two-thirds of the world population. For this 2023 item, its GDP-share figure aligns with the stored response. Keep the source’s word “around”: 85% is a rounded share, not an exact accounting value.

Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1917183&lang=2&reg=48
